title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. An input string is valid if: Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets, Open brackets must be closed in the correct order, Every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket of the same type.
hints: Think about a data structure that handles Last-In-First-Out order.
A stack is perfect. Push opening brackets, pop and check when you see a closing bracket.

optimalSolution.approach: Use a stack. Push opening brackets. When closing bracket encountered, check if top of stack matches. If stack is empty at end, string is valid.

followUpQuestions: What is the time complexity of your solution?
What happens if the string has only one character?
Can you solve this without a stack?
interviewerNotes: Classic stack problem. Candidate should immediately identify stack as the right data structure. Look for correct handling of empty stack check and mismatch detection.
